Land of Fairy

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Land_of_Fairy

Also known as the Fey-Realm.

Features

*There are paths in the Kingswood that lead through the Land of Fairy; the Bound Bargainers dwell in these passages and truck with fey. *Fey live here *The Orphans’ Road might be one of the paths that pass through the Fey-Realm *The many doors of the Holt (29.07) might be one and the same with the paths through the Fey-Realm, or they might be another means of egress that also uses the Fey-Realm. The former seems most likely. *Raiders will avoid the Loyal by using pre-arranged passages through the Fey-Realm. Category:Planes Category:Elves Category:Fey
